principles.statement: The struct you serialize to disk and the struct you parse from disk are a contract; a mismatch fails SILENTLY as 'not found', never loudly as a type error.
principles.rationale: Live 2026-09-20: the code pipeline wrote PersistedCodeGraph (analysis field) while its loader parsed the in-process CodeGraph shape (modality/metadata) — every parse failed on every persisted graph, surfacing only as empty results.

principles.statement: Any field added to persisted JSON must also exist on the typed schema that round-trips it, or serde strips it on the very next write.
principles.rationale: graph_hops was written by the pipelines into relationship edges and silently dropped by the host's typed Relation struct on every UpdateContainer — provenance vanished until Relation gained the field.

principles.statement: Write persisted graph content under the same key every reader resolves it by, and prefer writing under BOTH the container's own store path and the container-id-keyed path.
principles.rationale: Files keyed only by a process-local timestamp id were invisible to every other process; the container-id key is the cross-process contract.

heuristics.name: Adding or renaming a field in any persisted JSON structure.
heuristics.description: Update the typed struct in the same change; grep every constructor; add a round-trip test that writes the real shape and parses it back through the real loader.

heuristics.name: A loader returns 'not found' or empty for data you can see on disk.
heuristics.description: Diff the file's actual JSON keys against the parsing struct's fields before touching anything else — the mismatch is usually one renamed field.

decision_rules.condition: Introducing any new persisted field or file.
decision_rules.action: The typed schema, the writer, every reader, and a write-then-read round-trip test land in the same commit.
